description: handle_mdn_send (mdn.rs:191-198) rejects entries where forEmailId is None with a per-entry invalidProperties notSent error. No integration test exercises this path. Tests 1-8 in mdn_integration.rs cover success, mdnAlreadySent, notFound (email), missing mdnsent patch, null onSuccessUpdateEmail, and parse cases, but nothing sends an entry with forEmailId absent or null and asserts the response is notSent[key].type == 'invalidProperties' with properties=['forEmailId']. The path is reachable because Mdn.for_email_id is Option<Id> and the JSON field has skip_serializing_if=Option::is_none, meaning a client can omit it or send null and hit this branch silently untested. File: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs:191-198, crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/mdn_integration.rs.
title: MDN/send: no test for null/absent forEmailId per-entry invalidProperties
